title: Supervisor comment record (one JSON object per line)
description: Route B of the distillation protocol: a supervisor's margin comment on a draft, coded with defect codes (vocab/defects.yaml) and/or research-move codes (vocab/research-moves.yaml). Advisor and draft identifiers must be pseudonymous.

section.description: e.g. 引言 / 文献回顾 / 研究设计 / 案例分析 / 结论

action.description: what the supervisor asked the author to do, as an imperative

generalizable.description: true if the comment states a reusable judgement rather than a draft-specific fix
